title: Configuration Input Read as a Boundary-Aware Bit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state-set Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $w$ be a binary input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $w$. The symbol read by the input head equals the boundary-aware input symbol of $w$ at the input-head position: it is absent at position $0$ or beyond the final input position, and otherwise is the bit at index one less than that position.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration c of M on w
